title: Efficient summarization with read-again and copy mechanism

numbers.sentence: This results in a training set of 3.8M articles, a validation set and a test set each containing 400K articles.
The average sentence length is 31.3 words for the source, and 8.3 words for the summaries.
The average sentence length is 31.3 words for the source, and 8.3 words for the summaries.
We use dropout rate of 0.2 in all activation layers.
Our RNN cells in all models have 1 layer, 512-dimensional hidden states, and 512-dimensional word embeddings.
We start with an initial learning rate of 2, and halve it every epoch after first 5 epochs.
As computing the soft-max is usually the bottleneck for decoding, reducing vocabulary size dramatically reduces the decoding time from 0.38 second per sentence to 0.08 second.
